comment: The Haro v0.3 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.3 grows v0.2 by what the machine language's 25 remaining fixtures could not say (haro/SPIKE.md, the second rung): a UNION seat type (a value of one of several shapes: dhcp or an address/prefix; none or a list), a reference seat's own MESSAGES on its declaration, and a condition language that reads THROUGH a reference (network.domain on a peer), quantifies over a kind or a list of references (some, all, named, where, this.), tests a FORMAT (matches) and five closed relations (within, host_of, under, covers, cyclic) -- each total, each a fixed line of the court, none a computation the declaration writes. Every v0.2 fixture still passes: v0.3 refuses nothing v0.2 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a UNION is a seat type OF several types told apart by the value's shape: a word from a MENU or a text of a FORMAT; the union speaks when the value fits neither
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT address_prefix AS (SHAPE cidr, MESSAGE "'{value}' is not an address/prefix (a.b.c.d/n)") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, address_prefix], MESSAGE "ADDRESS is dhcp or an address/prefix (a.b.c.d/n)") RATIONALE "a network learns its address or declares it"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text, address: address]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a UNION alternative may be a list of a FORM: none, or the destinations
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU none_only AS (WORDS [none]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT prefix AS (SHAPE cidr) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM destination AS (SEATS [prefix: prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION egress AS (OF [none_only, [destination]]) RATIONALE "a way out is none, or a list of destinations"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text, egress: egress?]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: MESSAGES on a declaration: what the court says, per reference seat, when the name resolves to nothing
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION capability AS (VERB "CAPABILITY", SEATS [grant: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION user AS (VERB "USER", SEATS [uid: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word], needs: [capability], user: user?], MESSAGES [needs: "{name} needs {value}, which no declaration grants", user: "{name} runs as '{value}', and no USER of that name is declared"]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a condition reads THROUGH a reference seat: network.domain and network.address on a peer are the referenced NETWORK's seats
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT address_prefix AS (SHAPE cidr) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, address_prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text, address: address, domain: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [network: network, address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT peers_need_a_domain AS (ON peer, WHEN "network.domain absent", MESSAGE "PEER {name} is on {network}, and {network} declares no DOMAIN") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT no_peers_on_dhcp AS (ON peer, WHEN "network.address = dhcp", MESSAGE "PEER {name} is on {network}, which asks for its own address") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: the closed relations: within (an address in a prefix), host_of (the prefix's own address), under (a path prefix), covers (a list of prefixes covers one), cyclic (a list of references returns to its declaration), and matches (a FORMAT); self is the declaration's own name
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU none_only AS (WORDS [none]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT address_prefix AS (SHAPE cidr) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT wire_name AS (SHAPE label) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM destination AS (SEATS [prefix: address_prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, address_prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION egress AS (OF [none_only, [destination]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text, address: address, egress: egress?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [network: network, address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word], after: [service]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [identity: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT on_the_link AS (ON peer, WHEN "not address within network.address", MESSAGE "{address} is not on {network} ({network.address})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT not_the_box AS (ON peer, WHEN "address host_of network.address", MESSAGE "{address} is the machine's own address on {network}") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_wire_name AS (ON peer, WHEN "not self matches wire_name", MESSAGE "'{name}' cannot be a name on the wire") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT no_cycle AS (ON service, WHEN "after cyclic", MESSAGE "AFTER forms a cycle through {name}: no order starts it") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_perimeter AS (ON network, WHEN "egress covers '0.0.0.0/0'", MESSAGE "EGRESS names a perimeter, and these destinations together cover every address there is") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_key_under_a_mount AS (ON box, WHEN "identity present and not identity under '/data'", MESSAGE "IDENTITY {identity} is not under /data") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: quantifiers: some KIND named VALUE where COND, all LISTSEAT where COND; inside, a bare seat is the quantified declaration's and this.SEAT is the ON declaration's; {other} names the one that failed
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU yes_no AS (WORDS [yes, no]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU filesystems AS (WORDS [ext4, vfat, tmpfs]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION capability AS (VERB "CAPABILITY", SEATS [grant: yes_no]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION pin AS (VERB "PIN", SEATS [gpio: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word], needs: [capability]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text, fs: filesystems]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [identity: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT pins_need_gpio AS (ON pin, WHEN "not some capability named gpio where grant = yes", MESSAGE "PIN {name} needs gpio, and no declaration grants gpio") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT needs_are_granted AS (ON service, WHEN "not all needs where grant = yes", MESSAGE "{name} needs {other}, which is declared and refused (GRANT no)") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_key_is_kept AS (ON box, WHEN "identity present and not some mount where (fs = ext4 or fs = vfat) and this.identity under at", MESSAGE "IDENTITY {identity} is where the key lives, and no declared MOUNT keeps it") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.2 declaration is a v0.3 declaration: v0.2's A7, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU caps AS (WORDS [filesystem, network]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word], ready: text?, needs: [caps], uid: number?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD machine AS (ONE [box], FIRST box) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT no_root AS (ON service, WHEN "uid = 0", MESSAGE "uid 0 is the machine itself") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT run_names_a_program AS (ON service, WHEN "run empty", MESSAGE "RUN must name a program: the argv is empty") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_ready_path AS (ON service, WHEN "ready present and not ready unique", MESSAGE "one path signals for one service") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT needs_once AS (ON service, WHEN "not needs distinct", MESSAGE "saying it twice says nothing the once did not") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT touch_owns_no_mounts AS (ON mount, WHEN "box.profile = touch", MESSAGE "The touch profile owns no mounts") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT sees_needs_a_mount AS (ON service, WHEN "needs contains filesystem and not exists mount", MESSAGE "there is no sight to apportion") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a UNION requires its OF
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a UNION names at least two alternatives
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an alternative resolves to something
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, prefix]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a UNION's alternatives are told apart by shape, so two of one shape are refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU static_only AS (WORDS [static]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, static_only]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an alternative is a value type -- a MENU, a RANGE, a FORMAT, a primitive or a list of a FORM -- never a DECLARATION
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION user AS (VERB "USER", SEATS [uid: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION who AS (OF [dhcp_only, user]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a UNION is not a list seat's element
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT address_prefix AS (SHAPE cidr) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, address_prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [addresses: [address]]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: MESSAGES speaks for a reference seat, not for a seat whose type speaks for itself
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU policies AS (WORDS [never, always]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: policies?], MESSAGES [restart: "x"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: MESSAGES speaks for a reference seat

rejects.name: a MESSAGES key is a seat of the declaration
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION user AS (VERB "USER", SEATS [uid: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [user: user?], MESSAGES [colour: "x"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: X.seat in a condition reads through a reference seat of the ON declaration, or the one declaration of a ONE kind; a seat of another type is neither
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name, kernel: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "profile.kernel = linux", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the seat read through a reference is a seat of the referenced declaration
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [network: network]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON peer, WHEN "network.colour = blue", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: matches names a FORMAT of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON peer, WHEN "not self matches blue", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: some and all quantify over a declaration kind or a list of references
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "some colour where profile = x", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a declaration kind or a list of references

rejects.name: named narrows a kind by the declaration's name; a list of references is already named
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION capability AS (VERB "CAPABILITY", SEATS [grant: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [needs: [capability]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON service, WHEN "all needs named gpio where grant = yes", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: this.SEAT is read inside some or all, where a bare seat is the quantified declaration's
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [identity: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "this.identity present", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: this.SEAT names a seat of the ON declaration
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [identity: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "some mount where this.colour present", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: inside a quantifier a bare seat is the quantified declaration's: a seat it lacks is refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "some mount where profile = x", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the relations are a closed menu: within, host_of, under, covers, cyclic, matches
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [network: network, address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON peer, WHEN "address inside network.address", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: cyclic follows a list of references to the declaration's own kind
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON service, WHEN "run cyclic", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: cyclic follows a list of references

rejects.name: covers takes a list seat on its left
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON network, WHEN "interface covers '0.0.0.0/0'", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a relation's right side read through a reference is a seat of the referenced declaration
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [network: network, address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON peer, WHEN "address within network.colour", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"
